claims_tested: Theta_1 is computable exactly on a real 16S backbone with |E| = 21,147 and |R| = 10,575 (29 travellers' diarrhoea stool samples, no ground truth).

Across all 296 real krepp ANI cases - not the 15-case subsample of stage 296 - the measured estimation residual against the exact partner is compared with Theta_1, Theta_2, Theta_3 to give the implied m(eps).
A second real distance estimator (krepp placement distances) is placed on the same axis, or refused with a machine-readable reason.
decision_rules: Theta_k is decided ONLY by frozen stage-296 code: theta_support, theta_min_over_supports, independent_deviation, witness_sources.
The stage-298 k=1 closed form is accepted only where it agrees with the frozen LP by exact rational equality; every edge of every case is compared.
A (case, k) cell is RUN when C(|E|, k) <= support_cap[k], CENSORED otherwise; censored cells are reported with their support count and the measured seconds per support, never estimated away.
k = 2 and k = 3 are swept with cutoff = Theta_{k-1}; if no support is strictly below, Theta_k = Theta_{k-1} exactly and is recorded as such.
m(eps) = min{k : Theta_k < eps} for eps > 0, stage 296's registered convention (strict inequality).

No source count is claimed for any real sample: no ground truth exists for the travellers' samples, and for the krepp cases the generating taxa are known but the estimated distances are not exactly explainable.
Stage 291's inadmissible-floor construction is not used anywhere.
imported_without_recomputation: results/stage296/stage296_calibration.json: the 24 krepp ANI residual rows stage 296 measured (15 of which it placed against Theta_k).  Stage 298 extends the same formula to all 356 real cases and requires exact rational equality on those 24 rows as the validation of the extension.
purpose: Every incompleteness measurement in this project so far runs on instances with synthetic planted sources.  Stage 296 built the instrument that makes a real-data statement possible without ground truth: Theta_1, the exact smallest tolerance at which a SINGLE source explains the observations, is a rational number computable from the data alone.  This stage computes it on three real collections and places them on one axis, in observation units and relative to each sample's median observed distance.
